General.a: ihiring automates hiring with Sam, an AI interviewer that screens resumes, automates scheduling, conducts interviews 24/7, and delivers actionable reports.

General.q: Which ATS and Job boards platforms are supported?
General.a: We integrate seamlessly with Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Bullhorn, LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor and more.

General.q: Does ihiring work for staffing and enterprises?
General.a: Yes, we support both staffing and enterprises, with customized integrations optimized for their business needs.
Sam, provides detailed reports with interview videos, transcripts, and performance summaries, delivering actionable insights to support client hiring decisions.

General.q: As a candidate interviewing on the ihiring platform, what guidelines should I follow?
General.a: As a candidate preparing for an interview on the ihiring platform, it's advisable to approach it as you would any other interview. Maintain composure and authenticity to ensure a productive and enjoyable experience. For detailed guidelines, please visit our blog.

Core Features.q: How does Sam select the top candidate's application?
Core Features.a: Sam uses AI and ML to analyze resumes, rank profiles, and identify the best-fit candidate's application.

Core Features.q: Can Sam schedule interview calls and be available 24/7?
Core Features.a: Yes, busy working candidates can schedule interviews with Sam anytime, including evenings, nights and weekends, ensuring 24/7 flexibility to engage top talent effectively.

Core Features.q: Does Sam conduct live 1:1 interviews and analyze the interview to provide a report?
Core Features.a: Yes, Sam conducts live 1:1 concurrent video interviews and technical assessments 24/7, anywhere in the world. Sam writes and delivers detailed, unbiased interview reports after each stage, enabling quick, informed, merit-based decisions.

Core Features.q: Does Sam test skills and prevent candidate cheating?
Core Features.a: Sam uses advanced monitoring techniques to assess skills and detect any form of cheating, ensuring a fair and accurate evaluation process.

Tips for Interviewing with
Sam, on ihiring
February 22, 2025

Firstly, congratulations! Receiving an invitation to an interview is the first step toward advancing your career and achieving your future goals. ihiring is an AI-driven, candidate-focused interview platform that empowers talented individuals like you to shine.

What is an interview on ihiring?

An interview on ihiring involves a live conversation with Sam, our AI recruiter, conducted via video interview call, same as any other interview. Unlike the other interviews, the process is designed to be fair and consistent, eliminating human biases or variables like recruiter mood or skill level as Sam only cares about your knowledge and is never biased.

What’s required from you?

Video calls on ihiring are like those on Zoom or Teams. Strong and stable internet service is essential for the interview. Choose a quiet, distraction-free environment with good lighting if using video, and dress appropriately.

Consider it like your other interview.

Approach the conversation as you would a standard job interview. Highlight your experience, problem-solving skills, and industry knowledge. Review your resume, align your skills with the job requirements, and research the company if applicable. You can keep your notes next to you. But do not use any external tools like search engines or AI during the call and stay focused.

Most important, be yourself.

Stay calm and authentic—this is your opportunity to showcase your personality and capabilities. Speak naturally, focus on clarity, and convey enthusiasm. The goal is to make the experience both productive and enjoyable.
